name: Samuel P Taylor SP
description: Samuel P. Taylor State Park in west Marin has 2,882 acres of redwood groves along Lagunitas Creek, oak grasslands, and hikes to Barnabe Peak.
fullDescription: Samuel P. Taylor State Park in west Marin has 2,882 acres of redwood groves along Lagunitas Creek, oak grasslands, and hikes to Barnabe Peak.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hiking, biking, and horseback riding trails, including the Cross Marin Trail
- Tent, RV, group, equestrian, and hike-and-bike campsites, plus cabins (reserve at ReserveCalifornia.com)
- Picnic areas and interpretive programs
- Creek access closed December 1 to June 15 each year to protect salmon
howToGetIt:
- Vehicle day use: $8
- Camping: reserve at ReserveCalifornia.com
- Park phone: (415) 488-9897

**Passes accepted at this park:**
- **California State Library Parks Pass**: Free vehicle day use; check one out from your public library
- **Golden Bear Pass**: Free vehicle day use for income-eligible Californians
- **Senior Golden Bear Pass**: $20/year for ages 62+ (not valid in peak season)
- **Disabled Discount Pass**: 50% off vehicle day use and camping
- **Distinguished Veteran Pass**: Free vehicle day use and camping for eligible veterans
- **Free Fourth Grade Pass**: Free vehicle day use for California 4th graders and their families
address: 8888 Sir Francis Drake Blvd, Lagunitas, CA, 94938
keywords: Samuel P Taylor, state park, Marin County, redwoods, camping, hiking, biking, Lagunitas Creek, salmon
